title: Design: the bulk bar pushes the matrix list down but not sideways
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Take a screenshot of the matrix list.
  4. Check matrix A.
  5. Click Set Rule with the value empty.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The screenshot is saved.

Step 4:

  • The bar appears at the top of the list and the list moves down below it.
  • Compared with the screenshot, every column heading keeps its same left-right place and order; only the rows moved down, as pictures 2.32 and 2.47 show.

Step 5:

  • The error line appears under the bar.
  • The headings move further down but keep their same left-right place, as in picture 2.51.
